title: Twins and Co-Twins in Circulant graphs
summary: Circulant graphs are a widely studied family of graphs whose members possess varying amounts of symmetry. Although considerable progress has been made in finding the automorphism groups of circulant graphs under certain restrictions, a complete classification is elusive. In general, the structure of the automorphism group of a graph with twins can be simplified by separating the effect of automorphisms that permute mutually twin vertices and those that operate on the twin quotient graph.
